title: DoD officials advise against disclosure

tellings.quote: I've spoken with some very respectable high-level people in in the in the Department of Defense and some of those in which you know. and the advice has always been people it's it's people will not see what you see.

plain: A man named Dave Rossi, on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2025, says he has spoken with respected high-level people in the Department of Defense, the US military's headquarters, about going public with what he knows about non-human intelligence. He says their advice has always been the same: people will not see what you see, meaning the public would not accept it.
